messages.author: 8d587ec0858ae795
messages.subject: Downloading data filtered server-side
parts:
I am trying for my purposes this example:

https://yihui.shinyapps.io/DT-info/

Now my data are large so I used server side processing.
Data are shown and filtered fine.
Now how can I reuse the result of this filtering and download it in CSV format as it is shown for client side processing in the same example?

Regards

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Downloading data filtered server-side
parts:
Sorry, currently it is not possible. As explained at
http://rstudio.github.io/DT/shiny.html, server-side processing means
we only know one page of data each time, unless you choose to display
all pages of data through the length menu.

Regards,
Yihui
